# John Furey

Founder

Advisor Growth Strategies

John Furey is the founder of Advisor Growth Strategies (AGS), a consulting firm providing customized practice management solutions for independent advisory firms and financial advisors in transition. John is also the Managing Member of aRIA (the Alliance for RIAs), a think tank of seven leading independent advisory firms. John has a passion for making a difference in the industry and helping owners optimize their results for their clients and teams.

Prior to founding AGS, John was managing director of strategic business development for Schwab Advisor Services™, where he was responsible for recruiting new advisors and developing Schwab’s related sales and marketing capabilities. John has authored numerous research reports, white papers, and articles, and has been quoted in industry and national publications. Investment Advisor magazine recognized him as one of the most influential people in financial services through its “IA25” list. John has a bachelor’s degree in accounting and economics from the State University of New York and a master of business administration degree from Arizona State University.
